name: Oracle Database Administration
certifications: Oracle Database Administration 2019 Certified Professional (1Z0-082 and 1Z0-083)
Oracle Cloud Database Services Certified Professional

beginner.summary: For junior DBAs, developers and support engineers new to Oracle Database. Covers architecture, installation, the multitenant model, instance start-up and shut-down, networking, storage, users and security, schema objects, the data dictionary, undo and redo, transactions and locks, Data Pump, RMAN backups, the scheduler, monitoring and day-to-day DBA tasks.
prerequisites: Comfortable on the Linux command line
Knows what a relational database is
outcomes: Install Oracle Database and create container and pluggable databases
Manage storage, users, privileges and schema objects
Take and restore backups with RMAN and Data Pump
Carry out daily DBA checks and fix common problems

days.topic: Oracle Database Architecture Overview and Installation Setup
subtopics: Oracle Database editions and versions: 19c and 23ai
Background processes: DBWn, LGWR, CKPT, SMON and PMON
Physical files: data files, control files and redo logs
Installing the software with the installer and the preinstall package
Oracle Database Free and container images for practice
days.lab_task: Prepare an Oracle Linux server with the preinstall package, install Oracle Database software, create a database with DBCA and list its processes, memory areas and files.
days.deliverable: Install notes and an architecture sheet of the lab database
checks: DBWn, LGWR, SMON and PMON identified

subtopics: Connecting as SYSDBA with OS authentication
Bind and substitution variables in brief
days.lab_task: Connect as SYSDBA and as a normal user with SQL*Plus, SQLcl and SQL Developer, run a monitoring script with formatted output and spool it to a file.
days.deliverable: Connection notes, script and spooled report
checks: Session opened to the right service
Show the current user and container

days.lab_task: Create two PDBs from the seed, open them and save their state, create a common user and a local user, clone one PDB and unplug and plug another.
days.deliverable: Command log and container list
checks: Connect as the local user to the other PDB

days.topic: Starting Up and Shutting Down the Database
subtopics: Start-up stages: NOMOUNT, MOUNT and OPEN
Shutdown modes: NORMAL, IMMEDIATE, TRANSACTIONAL and ABORT
days.lab_task: Start the database stage by stage, create a PFILE from the SPFILE, change a parameter with each scope, shut down with ABORT and read instance recovery messages in the alert log.
days.deliverable: Command log and alert log extract
checks: Start in NOMOUNT and query v$instance
Read the alert log after ABORT

days.topic: Oracle Net: Listener and Service Names
subtopics: Creating services with DBMS_SERVICE or srvctl
days.lab_task: Configure the listener, create a service for an application in a PDB, add a tnsnames entry, connect through it and diagnose ORA-12514 and ORA-12541 errors.
days.deliverable: Network configuration files and diagnosis notes

days.lab_task: Create application data and index tablespaces, add a data file, enable autoextend, fill a tablespace until it errors and fix it, then write a free-space report.
days.deliverable: Tablespace scripts and free-space report
checks: ORA-01653 raised and fixed by adding space
Used and free space per tablespace
Table and index segments in their tablespaces

subtopics: Granting with ADMIN and GRANT options
days.lab_task: Create an application schema-only account, a read-only reporting role, a developer role and a profile with password rules, then test what each user can and cannot do.
days.deliverable: Security script and access test results
checks: Log in to the schema-only account
Update a table as the reporting user

days.topic: Schema Objects: Tables, Constraints and Sequences
subtopics: The recycle bin and FLASHBACK TABLE ... TO BEFORE DROP
days.lab_task: Create an orders schema with constraints, identity columns, a sequence and synonyms, drop a table by mistake and recover it from the recycle bin.
days.deliverable: DDL script and recovery output
checks: Drop and flash back the table

subtopics: Bitmap indexes and when to use them
days.lab_task: Index the orders schema for common queries, compare plans with Autotrace, make an index invisible to test its effect and create a view for reporting.
days.deliverable: Index scripts, plans and view definition
checks: Run a query before and after the index
Plan changes to an index range scan
Plan goes back to a full scan
Query the view as the reporting user

days.topic: The Data Dictionary and Dynamic Performance Views
subtopics: Finding sessions and what they run
days.lab_task: Write a set of dictionary queries: largest segments, invalid objects, users and their roles, active sessions with their SQL, and objects across all PDBs.
days.deliverable: Script library with sample output
checks: Session, user and SQL text shown
Objects from each PDB listed with CON_ID

subtopics: Archive destinations and the fast recovery area
days.lab_task: Put the database in ARCHIVELOG mode, add a redo log member, force log switches, configure the fast recovery area and reproduce and fix ORA-01555.
days.deliverable: Configuration commands and log status output

days.lab_task: Create blocking between two sessions, find the blocker in v$session, cause a deadlock and read its trace file, and use FOR UPDATE NOWAIT in an application query.
days.deliverable: Session transcripts and trace extract
checks: Use NOWAIT on a locked row

subtopics: Filtering with INCLUDE, EXCLUDE and QUERY
days.lab_task: Export a schema, import it into another PDB with a new schema name and tablespace, export one table with a filter and restart an interrupted job.
days.deliverable: Parameter files, logs and verification queries
checks: Objects created in the new schema
Job completes from where it stopped

days.lab_task: Configure RMAN retention and autobackup, take a level 0 and a level 1 backup with archive logs, list and validate them and delete obsolete backups.
days.deliverable: RMAN configuration, scripts and LIST output
checks: Old backups listed by the retention policy

subtopics: Recovery from a lost redo log member
days.lab_task: Delete a data file and recover it, lose a redo member and fix it, restore a control file from autobackup and recover a PDB while the others stay open.
days.deliverable: Recovery logs for each scenario
checks: Tablespace back online with all rows

days.lab_task: Schedule a nightly statistics job, a weekly purge of old audit rows and a shell script job with credentials, and check their logs and failures.
days.deliverable: Job definitions and job log output
checks: Old rows removed and the run logged
Failure and error shown in the job log

days.lab_task: Write a daily health check script that reports alert log errors, space, backups, failed jobs and blocking sessions, schedule it and email the report.
days.deliverable: Health check script and a sample report
checks: Insert an ORA- error into the alert log test

subtopics: Reading an execution plan with DBMS_XPLAN
When to call for deeper tuning
days.lab_task: Load data so statistics go stale, see the bad plan, gather statistics and see the plan change, then find the top SQL by elapsed time.
days.deliverable: Plans before and after and a top SQL report

subtopics: Release Updates and Release Update Revisions
days.lab_task: Apply a Release Update to a lab Oracle home with OPatch, run datapatch for all PDBs, confirm the patch level and practise rolling it back.
days.deliverable: Patch log, inventory output and rollback notes

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Building and Protecting an Application Database
days.lab_task: Create a PDB for an order application with tablespaces, schema and roles, load data with Data Pump, set up RMAN backups and a health check, then recover from a lost data file in front of the group.
days.deliverable: Build scripts, backup configuration, health report and recovery demo
checks: All checks green after the fix
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one database

intermediate.summary: For DBAs who run Oracle databases day to day. Covers RMAN strategies, flashback, memory, AWR, ASH and ADDM, SQL tuning, optimizer statistics, partitioning, Data Guard, ASM, Resource Manager, unified auditing, TDE, PDB cloning and refresh, Enterprise Manager, transportable tablespaces, patching, PL/SQL for DBAs, Autonomous Database on OCI and the 1Z0-083 exam.
prerequisites: Administers Oracle Database with RMAN and Data Pump
outcomes: Design backup and recovery with RMAN and flashback
Diagnose performance with AWR, ASH and SQL tuning tools
Run Data Guard standbys and ASM storage
Secure, patch and clone databases and work with Oracle Cloud

days.topic: RMAN Backup Strategies and the Recovery Catalog
subtopics: Backing up to tape or cloud storage
days.lab_task: Set up a recovery catalog, enable block change tracking, run an incrementally updated backup strategy with encryption and duplicate the production database to a test server.
days.deliverable: Catalog setup, scripts and duplication log
checks: Restore an encrypted backup without the password
Test database open with production data

days.lab_task: Recover wrong updates with flashback query, rewind a table, create a guaranteed restore point before a release and flash the database back after a failed deployment.
days.deliverable: Command log and recovery evidence
checks: Flash back the database to the restore point
Changes after the restore point gone
Pick a feature for three scenarios

subtopics: Shared pool, buffer cache and redo log buffer
days.lab_task: Read the buffer cache and PGA advisors, resize the SGA based on them, configure huge pages on Linux and set per-PDB memory limits.
days.deliverable: Advisor output, configuration changes and reasons
checks: Estimated physical reads at each size
SGA in huge pages after restart

days.topic: AWR, ASH and ADDM Performance Diagnosis
days.lab_task: Run a workload with a bottleneck, take snapshots, read the AWR report, use ASH to find the sessions and SQL behind the top wait and apply the ADDM recommendation.
days.deliverable: AWR report, ASH analysis and fix notes

days.topic: SQL Tuning with Execution Plans and Advisors
subtopics: Hints and when to avoid them
days.lab_task: Tune five slow statements: compare estimated and actual rows, use SQL Monitor for a long query, accept a SQL profile from the advisor and rewrite one statement.
days.deliverable: Tuning log with plans and timings

subtopics: Statistics on fixed objects and the dictionary
days.lab_task: Fix a skewed column estimate with a histogram, add extended statistics for correlated columns, test new statistics as pending before publishing and restore old statistics after a plan regression.
days.deliverable: Statistics scripts and plans before and after

subtopics: Range, list, hash and interval partitioning
Partition maintenance: split, merge, exchange and drop
days.lab_task: Convert an orders table to interval partitioning online, show partition pruning, exchange an old partition into an archive table and keep global indexes usable.
days.deliverable: Partitioning scripts, plans and maintenance log
checks: Plan shows pruning to one partition
Data moved instantly to the archive table
Drop a partition with UPDATE INDEXES

days.lab_task: Create a physical standby with RMAN duplicate, check redo apply, run a switchover and back, then fail over after stopping the primary.
days.deliverable: Configuration, switchover log and failover notes
checks: Roles swapped with no data loss

days.lab_task: Install Grid Infrastructure for a standalone server, create DATA and FRA disk groups, move a database into ASM with RMAN and add a disk while watching the rebalance.
days.deliverable: ASM configuration and move log
checks: DATA and FRA mounted with the chosen redundancy

days.lab_task: Create a plan that protects online users from reports, cancels queries over ten minutes, gives each PDB a CPU share and test it with a competing workload.
days.deliverable: Resource plans and test results
checks: Online group keeps its CPU share

subtopics: Sending audit data to a SIEM
days.lab_task: Create policies that audit logins, DBA actions and access to salary data, run tests, query the trail and set up a purge job with archiving.
days.deliverable: Policies, audit queries and purge job
checks: Action audited with the user and time
Old audit records removed after archiving

days.topic: Transparent Data Encryption and Network Encryption
days.lab_task: Create a keystore, encrypt an application tablespace online, rotate the master key, check that data files are unreadable outside the database and require encrypted client connections.
days.deliverable: Keystore setup, encryption log and connection test
checks: Search a data file for a known value
Value not found in plain text
New key active and data readable

days.lab_task: Hot clone a production PDB to a test CDB, make it refreshable and refresh it, relocate a PDB between CDBs with minimal downtime and apply a lockdown profile.
days.deliverable: Clone, refresh and relocation logs
checks: Run a blocked statement in the locked-down PDB

subtopics: Jobs and patching from Enterprise Manager
days.lab_task: Add a database to Enterprise Manager, apply a monitoring template, create incident rules for space and lag and use the performance hub to find a slow SQL statement.
days.deliverable: Monitoring configuration and incident examples

subtopics: Moving large databases with little downtime
Choosing between Data Pump and transport
days.lab_task: Move an application's tablespaces to another database with transportable tablespaces, check the set is self-contained and compare time with a normal Data Pump export.
days.deliverable: Transport log and time comparison

days.topic: Patching with OPatch, Out-of-Place Homes and Fleet Patching
days.lab_task: Build a patched gold image Oracle home, switch a database to it out of place, run datapatch and measure downtime compared with in-place patching.
days.deliverable: Patching runbook and downtime measurements
checks: Database runs from the patched home

days.lab_task: Write a DBA maintenance package that rebuilds unusable indexes, gathers stale statistics and reports failures, using bulk processing, dynamic SQL and error logging.
days.deliverable: Package code and run log
checks: Make an index unusable and run the package
Package runs with the intended privileges

days.topic: Oracle Databases on OCI and Autonomous Database
subtopics: What is automated and what is still yours
Cost and licensing (BYOL and licence included)
days.lab_task: Create an Autonomous Database, connect with a wallet, load data from object storage, scale CPU and compare tasks the DBA no longer performs with an on-premises database.
days.deliverable: Instance settings, load log and comparison table
checks: DBA tasks automated and remaining listed

days.lab_task: Take a timed practice exam, review each wrong answer against the documentation, practise weak areas in the lab and take a second practice exam.
days.deliverable: Two practice scores and a weak-areas list
checks: Each linked to a documentation section

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Protected and Tuned Production Database
days.lab_task: Take over an unprotected, slow order database: add a recovery catalog strategy, a Data Guard standby, TDE and auditing, tune its top SQL with AWR and advisors, then present results and a switchover demo.
days.deliverable: Configuration, tuning log, switchover demo and presentation
checks: Application reconnects to the new primary
Elapsed time reduced for each tuned statement
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one database

advanced.summary: For senior DBAs and database architects. Covers Real Application Clusters, Data Guard broker and fast-start failover, Maximum Availability Architecture, GoldenGate, Exadata, deep performance troubleshooting, SQL plan management, Database In-Memory, application containers, AutoUpgrade, migration to the cloud, Database Vault and hardening, information lifecycle management, sharding, JSON and AI Vector Search in 23ai, automation, licensing and production incidents.
prerequisites: Runs production Oracle databases with RMAN and Data Guard
Tunes SQL with AWR and execution plans
outcomes: Design highly available Oracle platforms with RAC, Data Guard and GoldenGate
Solve hard performance problems and keep plans stable
Upgrade and migrate large databases with little downtime
Secure, automate and run Oracle estates cost-effectively

subtopics: Clusterware, voting disks and the OCR
When RAC is not the answer
days.lab_task: Build a two-node RAC lab, create services with preferred and available instances, connect through SCAN and observe interconnect traffic under load.
days.deliverable: Cluster build log, service definitions and traffic notes
checks: All resources online on both nodes

days.lab_task: Run a rolling patch while an application uses Transparent Application Continuity, drain connections from a node, add a third node and diagnose a simulated eviction.
days.deliverable: Patch log, application logs and eviction diagnosis
checks: Patch node by node under load
Cause found in the cluster logs

days.topic: Data Guard Broker and Fast-Start Failover
days.lab_task: Configure the broker with fast-start failover and an observer, crash the primary, watch automatic failover and reinstatement, and use a snapshot standby for testing.
days.deliverable: Broker configuration, failover log and test notes
checks: Convert to a snapshot standby and back

subtopics: MAA tiers: bronze, silver, gold and platinum
Combining RAC, Data Guard and GoldenGate
days.lab_task: Design availability for three systems with different targets (internal reporting, online banking and a global payments hub), choose an MAA tier for each and justify cost and risk.
days.deliverable: Three architecture designs with reasoning
checks: Each tier meets its RTO and RPO
Infrastructure and licence cost per tier
Patching without downtime explained for each

days.lab_task: Replicate an orders schema from Oracle to another Oracle database and to PostgreSQL, run an initial load, handle a conflict in bidirectional mode and monitor lag.
days.deliverable: GoldenGate configuration, conflict notes and lag report

subtopics: Exadata in OCI and Cloud at Customer
days.lab_task: Run reporting queries on Exadata, show Smart Scan and storage index savings in statistics, compress a historical table with HCC and set IORM shares between databases.
days.deliverable: Statistics, compression results and IORM plan

days.topic: Advanced Performance Troubleshooting: Waits, Latches and Mutexes
subtopics: Hot blocks and buffer busy waits
days.lab_task: Diagnose three hard problems: hard parsing causing library cache contention, a hot block from a sequence and slow commits, using traces, ASH and OS data, and fix each.
days.deliverable: Trace analysis, fixes and before and after measurements
checks: Unbound SQL identified in the trace
Cause found in log writer and storage data

days.topic: SQL Plan Management and Plan Stability
days.lab_task: Capture baselines for key SQL, force a plan regression, show the baseline protecting the plan, evolve a better plan and use SQL Performance Analyzer to test a parameter change.
days.deliverable: Baselines, regression test and SPA report

subtopics: In-memory with RAC and Data Guard
days.lab_task: Enable the column store, populate a sales table, compare analytic query times with and without it and size the store with the advisor.
days.deliverable: Configuration, timing comparison and sizing report

days.topic: Multitenant at Scale and Application Containers
subtopics: Hundreds of PDBs in one CDB
Backup and recovery for many PDBs
days.lab_task: Create an application container for a SaaS app, install version 1, create three tenant PDBs, upgrade the application to version 2 and sync the tenants.
days.deliverable: Application scripts and sync log

subtopics: Upgrading and converting non-CDBs to PDBs
Replay and testing with Real Application Testing
days.lab_task: Upgrade a 19c non-CDB to 23ai as a PDB with AutoUpgrade, test with a captured workload replay and fall back with a restore point in a second attempt.
days.deliverable: AutoUpgrade configuration, logs, replay report and fallback notes

days.topic: Migrating Oracle Databases to the Cloud
subtopics: Migration options to OCI, AWS and Azure
RMAN, Data Pump and GoldenGate methods
days.lab_task: Plan the migration of three databases to the cloud with different methods, run a physical online migration with ZDM to OCI and validate the result.
days.deliverable: Migration plan, ZDM log and validation report
checks: Method chosen for each database with reasons

days.lab_task: Protect the HR schema with a realm so DBAs cannot read salaries, find unused privileges with privilege analysis, redact card numbers and fix the top DBSAT findings.
days.deliverable: Vault configuration, privilege report, redaction policy and DBSAT report

days.topic: Information Lifecycle Management and Large Data Volumes
subtopics: Moving old data to cheaper storage
days.lab_task: Enable heat map, create ADO policies that compress partitions unused for 90 days and move them to a low-cost tablespace, and measure space saved.
days.deliverable: Policies, policy run log and space report

days.topic: Oracle Sharding and Globally Distributed Databases
days.lab_task: Deploy a small sharded database, create sharded and duplicated tables for a customer schema, route connections by key and add a shard with rebalancing.
days.deliverable: Sharding configuration and routing evidence
checks: Query a duplicated table on each shard

days.topic: JSON, Duality Views and AI Vector Search in 23ai
days.lab_task: Expose orders as a duality view used by a JSON API, store product description embeddings in a VECTOR column, build a vector index and run filtered similarity search for a RAG prototype.
days.deliverable: Duality view, vector schema, queries and prototype
checks: Run a similarity search with a filter
Nearest products within the filter returned
Compare with and without the vector index

subtopics: Ansible for Oracle installs and patching
days.lab_task: Automate creating a patched database from a gold image with Ansible, provision an OCI database with Terraform and publish a health check through an ORDS REST endpoint.
days.deliverable: Ansible playbooks, Terraform code and REST endpoint
checks: Run the playbook on a fresh server

days.topic: Oracle Licensing, Consolidation and Cost Control
subtopics: Licence metrics: processor and named user plus
Options and packs and accidental use
Licensing on virtual machines and in clouds
days.lab_task: Review feature usage on three databases, find packs and options used without licences, design a consolidation onto multitenant and estimate savings.
days.deliverable: Usage review, consolidation design and savings estimate

subtopics: Working with Oracle Support and TFA
days.lab_task: Diagnose five injected incidents (a stuck archiver, a hang, a plan flip, an internal error and standby lag), collect diagnostics with TFA and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, TFA collection and a post-incident review

days.lab_task: Design and build a platform for a payments system: RAC with Application Continuity, Data Guard with fast-start failover, GoldenGate feed to analytics, Vault and auditing, plan baselines and automation, then run a game day with failover, rolling patching and an upgrade rehearsal.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, build automation, game day report and review presentation
checks: Run the failover in the game day
Design and cost choices defended with evidence
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
